title: ASA Aero magnetic float guide: current process and evidence sources
scope: One connected ASA Aero body and one RC62 inserted at a print pause. Current v2 CAD requires a fresh native slice review; the v1 project is identified print evidence.

sources.title: Bambu ASA Aero Technical Data Sheet
sources.scope: General filament guidance and material descriptors, not qualification of this foamed body in pressurized water or flavoring.

sources.title: Bambu ASA Aero Printing Guide
sources.retrieval: Existing manufacturer guide research; direct retrieval on 2026-10-03 unavailable.
sources.scope: Foaming process, one-object workflow, plate preparation and ventilation guidance.

sources.title: Bambu Engineering Plate troubleshooting guide
sources.scope: Warm water and dish-detergent cleaning; Bambu liquid glue on Engineering plate.

sources.title: K&J RC62 ring magnet
sources.scope: Component properties do not establish temperature or retained field during Aero overprinting.

sources.title: Littelfuse Reed Switch and Reed Sensor Activation

selected_process.drying: SUNLU E2, 80 C for 8 h; sealed Polymaker external drybox below 20% RH
selected_process.scope: The current v2 source retains this selected process; no v2 native archive has been prepared or submitted.

handling.cooling: Bed at 35 C or below before gently releasing the Engineering sheet.
handling.basis: Conservative shop handling choice; not an ASA-specific manufacturer release temperature.
handling.insertion: One RC62 on the pocket floor, below both rims, with the body fixed to its plate and guide bore open.
handling.resume: Manual resume after seating and clearing hands/tools.

evidence.scope: Reported v1 insertion and initial covering, plus a separately reported reed bench range. Final roof, cooled removal, density, buoyancy, retained field, liquid uptake, pressure life and flavor compatibility are unreported.
